section_summary.extract_value: This is an abstract of a single study examining the relationship between body image discrepancy and disordered eating behaviors in a sample of 369 women. The study investigates the mediating roles of cognitive fusion regarding physical appearance and body appreciation, while controlling for BMI. Results indicate that women perceiving significant body discrepancy show greater disordered eating tendencies, partially explained by higher cognitive fusion and lower body appreciation.
